snp4.15:1.1: NIṬṬHITAṂ. Attadaṇḍasutta. "Attadaṇḍā bhayaṃ jātaṃ, janaṃ passatha medhakaṃ, saṃvegaṃ kittayissāmi yathā saṃvijitaṃ mayā. || ||
snp4.15:2.1: Phandamānaṃ pajaṃ disvā macche appodake yathā aññamaññehi vyāruddhe disvā maṃ bhayam āvisi. || ||
snp4.15:3.1: Samantaṃ asaro loko, disā sabbā sameritā, icchaṃ bhavanam attano nāddasāsiṃ anositaṃ, || ||
snp4.15:4.1: osāne tv-eva vyāruddhe disvā me aratī ahu, -- ath' ettha sallaṃ addakkhiṃ duddasaṃ hadayanissitaṃ. || ||
snp4.15:5.1: Yena sallena otiṇṇo disā sabbā vidhāvati, tam eva sallaṃ abbuyha na dhāvati, nisīdati. || ||
snp4.15:6.1: Tattha sikkhānugīyanti: Yāni loke gathitāni, na tesu pasuto siyā, nibbijjha sabbaso kāme sikkhe nibbānam attano. || ||
snp4.15:7.1: Sacco siyā appagabbho amāyo rittapesuṇo akkodhano, lobhapāpaṃ vevicchaṃ vitare muni. || ||
snp4.15:8.1: Niddaṃ tandiṃ sahe thīnaṃ, pamādena na saṃvase, atimāne na tiṭṭheyya nibbānamanaso naro. || ||
snp4.15:9.1: Mosavajje na niyyetha, rūpe snehaṃ na kubbaye, mānañ ca parijāneyya, sāhasā virato care. || ||
snp4.15:10.1: Purāṇaṃ nābhinandeyya, nave khantiṃ na kubbaye, hīyamāne na soceyya, ākāsaṃ na sito siyā. || ||
snp4.15:11.1: Gedhaṃ brūmi "mahogho" ti, ājavaṃ brūmi jappanaṃ, ārammaṇaṃ pakappanaṃ, kāmapaṃko duraccayo. || ||
snp4.15:12.1: Saccā avokkamma muni thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo, sabbaṃ so paṭinissajja sa ve santo ti vuccati, || ||
snp4.15:13.1: sa ve vidvā, sa vedagū, ñatvā dhammaṃ anissito sammā so loke iriyāno na pihetīdha kassaci. || ||
snp4.15:14.1: Yo 'dha kāme accatari saṃgaṃ loke duraccayaṃ, na so socati nājjheti chinnasoto abandhano. || ||
snp4.15:15.1: Yaṃ pubbe, taṃ visosehi, pacchā te māhu kiñcanaṃ, majjhe ce no gahessasi, upasanto carissasi. || ||
snp4.15:16.1: Sabbaso nāmarūpasmiṃ yassa n' atthi mamāyitaṃ, asatā ca na socati, sa ve loke na jiyyati. || ||
snp4.15:17.1: Yassa n' atthi ‘idam me' ti ‘paresaṃ' vā pi kiñcanaṃ, mamattaṃ so asaṃvindaṃ ‘n' atthi me' ti na socati. || ||
snp4.15:18.1: Aniṭṭhuri ananugiddho anejo sabbadhī samo -- tam ānisaṃsaṃ pabrūmi pucchito avikampinaṃ. || ||
snp4.15:19.1: Anejassa vijānato n' atthi kācini saṃkhiti, virato so viyārambhā khemaṃ passati sabbadhi. || ||
snp4.15:20.1: Na samesu na omesu na ussesu vadate muni, santo so vītamaccharo nādeti na nirassatī" ti Bhagavā ti || || ATTADAṆḌASUTTAṂ
